start.speaker: Blue Bomb
start.text: Oh- hi- don't come too close- or do, it's fine, it's been like this since '94.

a_bomb.speaker: Blue Bomb
a_bomb.text: I was. I am? I'm- it's more of a title now. Like 'duke'.

situation.speaker: Blue Bomb
situation.text: The fuse is going. It's been going. Thirty years. It's not a fast fuse. It's a- it's a lifestyle, someone said. That was hurtful. Accurate. Hurtful.

choices.text: Thirty years is a long time.

long_time.speaker: Blue Bomb
long_time.text: I've seen every one of that shelf's tapes from here. From the floor. The labels, I mean. I know them by- sorry, I'm talking a lot, the fuse makes me chatty-

help.speaker: Blue Bomb
help.text: You'd- really? Okay. Okay okay okay. Three things. Sorry. It's three things.

help_key.speaker: Blue Bomb
help_key.text: One: the key. In my back. It keeps winding me. Something has to jam it. Something chewy- tape-y- I don't know, I've never seen my own back.

help_fuse.speaker: Blue Bomb
help_fuse.text: Two: the fuse. Wet it. Please don't blow on it. A man blew on it in '99 and we both cried.

help_wires.speaker: Blue Bomb
help_wires.text: Three: there are wires. In my chest. I've never looked. The shelf knows the order. The tapes. The labels know. I trust the labels.

help_end.speaker: Dorko
help_end.text: Key, fuse, wires. A to-do list with a heartbeat.

distance.speaker: Blue Bomb
distance.text: Smart. Sensible. I'd stand near me though. If you wanted. Nobody has in a while.

bye.speaker: Blue Bomb
bye.text: Thank you for- yes. Bye. I'll be here. That's not a threat. Sorry. Bye.

jammed_start.speaker: Blue Bomb
jammed_start.text: The key stopped. I feel- lighter? Is this what lighter feels like. Two more things. Sorry. The fuse, then the wires.

help_fuse_short.speaker: Blue Bomb
help_fuse_short.text: Wet. It needs to be wet. There's water in the heater behind me, if you can get the panel off, or- anything fizzy works. Historically. Don't ask about historically.

wet_start.speaker: Blue Bomb
wet_start.text: It's out- mostly out- it's smoldering politely. Just the wires now. They're in my chest. I'd look away but it's my chest.

wires_go.speaker: Blue Bomb
wires_go.text: Okay. Okay okay. Touch my- just, hands on the chest panel. I'll think about the ocean.

wires_order.speaker: Blue Bomb
wires_order.text: The shelf. The tape labels. They've been staring at me for thirty years - the least they can do is be instructions.

defused_start.speaker: Blue Bomb
text: I keep standing up. Just to do it. I've stood up nine times since you did the wires.
Is my fuse okay? It's nothing now. It's a wick. I'm a candle nobody has to worry about.
The room behind the arcade machine hums. I hear it at night. I hear everything at night. Sorry.

choices.text: Tell me about the hidden room.

what_now.speaker: Blue Bomb
what_now.text: I might roll somewhere. On purpose, I mean. I've only ever rolled from fear.

hidden.speaker: Blue Bomb
hidden.text: Behind the cabinet. Turquoise light under it. The coin door's lock takes something key-shaped- oh. OH. The key. My key. Take my key. It's the best thing I've ever said out loud.

defused_bye.speaker: Blue Bomb
defused_bye.text: You too. You- sorry. You first. Bye.
